plays.description: Lawrence completes a seam pass on the opening offensive play.
Lawrence throws incomplete to Thomas.
Swing-pass completion fails to reach the third-down marker; gain unspecified.
Schultz catches a high throw and is tackled by Dennis Gardeck; Houston goes three-and-out.
plays.coverage_scheme: showed zero blitz, then dropped into coverage

plays.description: Lawrence escapes pressure from Will Anderson and dives near midfield.
A downhill pitch gains a first down; ball carrier and yardage are not identified.
Lawrence targets Washington on an in-breaking route against a blitz; the next shown snap is fourth down.
Lawrence extends the fourth-down play, but Tremon Smith jumps the route and breaks up the pass.
Stroud quickly finds his hot read against an edge blitz for a first down.
Stroud uses play-action and a shoulder fake before finding Collins inside the 10.
Moreau catches a quick touchdown pass while wide open after a coverage breakdown.
plays.personnel_formation: empty; Woody Marks motions out of backfield

plays.description: Rodriguez breaks tackles and runs through arm tackles toward midfield.
Strange catches a third-down pass over the middle and gains enough for a first down.
Rodriguez breaks a tackle and reaches approximately the 30-yard line; commentary estimates eight to eight-and-a-half yards.
Rodriguez finds a large crease and bounces the run for approximately seven or eight yards.
Runner gets an extra push and reaches the line to gain.
Washington catches a sideline pass and steps out at the six.
A toss reaches the end zone, but a holding penalty on Brenton Strange nullifies the touchdown.
Lawrence's third-and-goal pass intended for Jakobi Meyers is intercepted by Calen Bullock in the end zone for a touchback.
plays.concept: pass to back of end zone

plays.description: Marks is stopped short on a third-down run.
Washington gets loose against a blitz, reaches the edge and gains a first down before Logan Hall stops him.
Lawrence drops a sideline pass over Kamari Lassiter's shoulder on third down.
Tuten catches a pass in the flat, follows Jakobi Meyers' block and weaves down the sideline for a touchdown.
plays.concept: pass to right flat; yards after catch

plays.description: Noel breaks free after the catch and reaches the Jacksonville 35.
plays.concept: short middle pass; yards after catch

plays.description: Stroud connects with Harrison on a crossing route near the goal line; exact spot and gain are unclear.
Schultz catches a tipped pass against a blitz and finishes approximately half a yard short of the first-down marker.
Fairbairn makes a 25-yard field goal to give Houston a 10–7 lead.
Cameron returns the kickoff past midfield, giving Jacksonville the ball at the Houston 48.
Rodriguez runs through contact for seven yards.
Meyers converts third-and-eight on an in-cutting route.
plays.personnel_formation: tight bunch right; Meyers in motion

plays.description: Hunter catches a pass over the middle down to the four with Tremon Smith trying to stay with him.
Lawrence rolls out and finds Tuten wide open for his second receiving touchdown.
Stroud completes a deep shot down the middle to Noel.
A pass to the right side of the end zone is incomplete, but defensive pass interference is called on Travis Hunter.
Moreau makes a one-handed touchdown catch over the defender's outstretched arms.
Schultz catches a slant for nine yards, with Antonio Johnson stopping him short of the first down.
Houston's punt bounces into the end zone, but Jacksonville's failure to get a defender off the field produces a five-yard penalty and a Houston first down.
Harrison catches Stroud's pass and gains 15 yards on an RPO.
Stroud releases quickly to Noel for a 10-yard first down.
Jordan takes a toss into the red zone behind an extra offensive lineman.
Houston uses tempo and a quick snap; Harrison catches another first-down pass against a three-man rush.
Stroud floats a touchdown pass to Noel; commentary praises the route.
plays.personnel_formation: Marvin Harrison Jr. in slot as No. 3 receiver

plays.description: Lawrence throws incomplete off his back foot after play-action; a defender rendered as 'usher' gets an arm in the passing lane.
Lawrence initially avoids the rush, but Tremon Smith knocks away the sideline pass to force a three-and-out.
Receiver makes a toe-tapping sideline catch for a first down on Stroud's rollout.
Jacksonville drops into zone and rushes four; Stroud scrambles toward the sideline but falls short of the first down.
Meyers catches a wide-open pass over the middle and runs beyond midfield. Commentary says 21 yards; the DB records 22.
plays.concept: short middle pass; yards after catch

plays.description: Jacksonville picks up the blitz, allowing Lawrence to find Meyers on a long sideline throw.
A screen reaches the edge and finishes inside the five, with Derek Stingley Jr. forcing the runner out; commentary also identifies a late defensive substitution.
plays.defender_beaten: Derek Stingley Jr. (tackler); Jadeveon Clowney (late substitution)

plays.description: Boerkircher makes a one-handed touchdown catch on a short pop pass after quarterback-run action.
Schultz catches a seam pass for 16 yards before Kaevon Merriweather stops him.
Stroud moves out of the pocket and throws sidearm to Hutchinson at the sideline.
plays.personnel_formation: empty backfield; Woody Marks in motion

plays.description: Houston targets Collins down the sideline against one-on-one coverage; Jaron Jones is called for pass interference.
Jordan takes a toss, finds a cutback lane and breaks a secondary tackle for a touchdown; DB records a run at left tackle.
Hunter catches a slant, breaks tackles and uses a stiff arm before reaching the Houston 30.
Washington catches a quick pass, stays in bounds and fights for a first down.
Following a fake to the motioning Jakobi Meyers, Hunter catches a throwback screen and splits defenders to reach the 11.
Rodriguez converts a third-down run to set up first-and-goal at the seven.
Hunter aligns in the backfield and catches a touchdown pass at the goal line.
Receiver holds on to a tight-window catch despite being driven backward by Kaevon Merriweather.
Stover takes a direct snap and gains a first down behind a push.
Marks gains seven yards on first down to the Jacksonville 46.
Collins comes back to help Stroud and converts for a first down against Travis Hunter.

plays.description: Marks makes a subtle move near the 25 and runs for a first down.
Collins catches a receiver screen in a one-on-one situation and reaches the nine before stepping out; Jordan Lewis brings him down.
plays.coverage_scheme: one-on-one on screen; broader scheme unspecified

plays.description: Travis Hunter undercuts the route intended for Xavier Hutchinson and intercepts Stroud's play-action pass in the end zone for a touchback.
plays.coverage_scheme: Hunter in trail on replay commentary; broader scheme unspecified

plays.description: Meyers bobbles but secures a pass over the middle.
Screen receiver follows a block and cutback lane for eight yards.
Lawrence looks left before returning over the middle; Bullock nearly intercepts the pass.
plays.coverage_scheme: outside leverage mentioned; full scheme unspecified

plays.description: Houston shows an all-out blitz and brings pressure; Strange reaches back for a catch at the 42.
Little makes a 60-yard field goal to tie the game at 31.
Stroud completes a pass against a blitz, approximately two yards short of the first down, while Josh Allen pressures him.
Marks catches a wide-open pass and runs to the sideline; replay commentary credits his release with freezing the linebackers.
plays.concept: pass to running back; yards after catch

plays.description: Jordan runs to the Jacksonville 32 to improve field-goal position with 47 seconds remaining.
Stover takes another direct snap and gets a short push before Houston drains the clock.
Fairbairn makes the winning 49-yard field goal as time expires.

offense_strengths: Stroud generated explosive completions to Collins for 42 yards and Noel for 34 and 50 yards.
Houston answered pressure with Hutchinson's hot-read first down and other quick completions, including a late completion under blitz pressure.
Moreau caught two short touchdowns, and Noel added a 13-yard receiving touchdown.
Harrison produced a 15-yard RPO gain; Jordan scored on a 25-yard toss with a cutback and later improved the winning field-goal position.
Stover converted a direct-snap run for a first down and handled another late direct snap.
defense_weaknesses: Jacksonville produced consecutive 22- and 28-yard completions to Meyers; commentary explicitly identified openings in the middle.
Tuten turned a flat pass into a 27-yard touchdown behind Meyers' block and was wide open on his second touchdown.
Hunter gained 26 yards on a slant with broken tackles, later split defenders on a throwback screen and caught a seven-yard touchdown.
Rodriguez repeatedly gained yards through contact, including a seven-yard run and a third-down conversion near the goal line.
Jacksonville picked up a Houston blitz on Meyers' 28-yard catch; Washington also caught a 27-yard pass over Lassiter against pressure.

offense_strengths: Lawrence distributed explosive passes to Strange, Washington, Meyers and Hunter.
Screens and short throws produced substantial gains: Tuten's 27-yard touchdown, Hunter's slant and throwback screen, and an eight-yard late screen.
Motion and backfield deployments featured in Meyers' third-down conversion, Hunter's throwback screen and Hunter's touchdown.
Rodriguez supplied repeated gains through contact and a red-zone third-down conversion.
Short scoring passes reached Tuten twice and Boerkircher once.
defense_weaknesses: Houston completed gains of 42 yards to Collins and 34 and 50 yards to Noel.
Commentary explicitly called Moreau's first touchdown a blown coverage.
Pass-interference penalties against Hunter and Jaron Jones helped Houston advance on scoring possessions.
A defender failing to leave the field erased a Houston punt and extended the possession that ended with Noel's touchdown.
Jordan found a cutback lane and broke a secondary tackle on his 25-yard touchdown.
Marks was wide open on a late catch-and-run; commentary credited his release with freezing the linebackers.

limitations: Analysis uses only supplied captions and DB excerpts; no video frames, browsing or commands. The DB excerpt omits many ordinary plays, so NO DB MATCH means no matching supplied line, not that the play did not occur. Caption times identify commentary segments and may include replay discussion. Unmatched garbled names remain unresolved; prior-play fragments and general discussion were not treated as separate plays. Exact gains are null when absent or only approximate; DB yardage takes precedence on clear matches. Field-goal yards are kick distances. The nullified rushing touchdown is not counted as a score. DB tacklers, pressure players, penalty offenders and pass-breakup defenders are labeled in defender_beaten for traceability; their inclusion does not establish they were beaten. Formations and coverage are limited to explicit commentary, with rush counts and partial descriptions distinguished from full schemes. No complete personnel groupings, route combinations, blocking assignments or coverage responsibilities can be established from these captions.
